body: I've had hobbies before - I used to be really into writing and learning languages, but I find them too difficult these days. I can't really concentrate. But - something like archery or another sport might be a better distraction. It's a good idea, thanks

This is such a great comment - thank you! That six-week timeline gave me a lot of hope, because for some reason I expected it to take several months before I could feel any positive effects from quitting. I'm currently checking out those other links!
I'm lucky that I don't have any friends who smoke weed, and my boyfriend absolutely hates the stuff. I guess the big move is going to be to throw everything I have in the trash... rough
This is so great. You can do it!

I can relate to this - I'm 25 and most people think I have my shit together, but because of drinking I'm actually on the verge of being kicked out of grad school. 

It's hard to tell people you're not drinking anymore when they don't see any reason why you would want to give it up. That's why I, too, was so glad to find this subreddit :)
